mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 3-month moving average compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS decline and 20d SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or positive returns occur in less than 55% of decline instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, restrictive monetary policy increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals broad consumer demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20d returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0%) signals reduced consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during high unemployment regimes.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 30% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate consistently reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in any macro regime.
failure_condition: The correlation between UNRATE and 20d SPX returns is not negative (Rank IC < -0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over the last 2 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPI (CPIAUCSL) and declines in retail sales (RSAFS) indicate stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of rising CPI and declining RSAFS fails to produce negative 20d returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST > 550.0) supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during strong consumer demand regimes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST > 550.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.
